retrievalProfile.description: A rugged, cinematic portrait featuring a tattooed subject in a natural water setting with wide, modern-retro typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a bearded, tattooed man wearing a dark wide-brimmed hat, partially submerged in a forest river. The image features a heavy film grain, muted earthy tones, and a distinct wide-set typographic block at the bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with head turned in profile
Water line bisecting the lower third of the subject's torso
Lush, out-of-focus forest background creating depth
Typography anchored in the lower third over the water surface
coreInvariants: Muted green and brown color palette
Wide-brimmed hat as a silhouette anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the middle 60% of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark hat provides a high-contrast anchor against the bright, blurred foliage.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the subject's gaze to the left, then drop down to the bold typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense foliage in the upper half acts as textured negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest greens and murky river browns
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale skin tones and off-white typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark charcoal/black of the hat and tattoos
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a crushed black point to simulate vintage film.

characterSpecificRedesigns: C and O are wide ovals
E has equal length horizontal bars
M and N have deep, sharp crotches
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic hierarchy using weight and scale of the same extended typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century modern yet rugged geometric feel.
Provides the necessary square-ish structure and wide stance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a bearded man with chest tattoos wearing a dark fedora, standing in a river with water up to his chest. Background is a lush, blurred forest. Apply heavy film grain and muted earthy tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, off-white, ultra-extended sans-serif text in the lower third. The top line should be large and bold; the bottom line should be smaller with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is there visible film grain across the whole image?
Is the subject's gaze directed toward the side?
Is the color palette dominated by muted greens and browns?

mustRedesign: Ensure tattoos are generic artistic patterns
Do not replicate specific celebrity likeness
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is centered and legible against the water
Ensure the hat silhouette is sharp against the background
Verify the film grain doesn't obscure the subject's features
Confirm the extended font width matches the reference style
recipe.reuseFormula: Rugged Portrait + Submerged Context + Ultra-Extended Sans-Serif Typography + Heavy Film Grain
